lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots organized into approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gill region, with the highest intensity clusters located mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows at near-right angles, forming a lattice where circular blobs act as vertices.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper dorsal-lateral boundary, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from a light upper edge to a darker shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily toward the base and anterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white, thin, linear markings resembling superficial scratches or abrasions are visible across the dorsal fin surface and the upper lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) positioned ventrally near the pectoral fin base.
